title: Late Fees Settled with the Balance According to the Arrears on the Project
content:
# Late Fees Settled with the Balance According to the Arrears on the Project

How much of the late fee history of a project under Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects is settled with the balance is measured by how much of the contract billings stands unpaid.

## Rule

Where the amount standing unpaid on the project's contract billings is more than a fifth of the contract value, that is more than **20 per cent** of it, every late fee raised on the project is settled with the balance: **100 per cent** of them.

Where the amount standing unpaid on the project's contract billings is more than a tenth of the contract value, that is more than **10 per cent** of it, but no more than a fifth, **50 per cent** of the late fees raised is settled with the balance.

Where the amount standing unpaid on the project's contract billings is a tenth of the contract value or less, no late fee is settled with the balance: **0 per cent**.

## The two boundaries

The amount standing unpaid on the contract billings is the deposit, mobilisation, progress and change order billings raised on the project less the retainage withheld from them and less every payment received; where that comes out below zero, nothing stands unpaid. Both the fifth and the tenth are taken on the contract value and rounded to the nearest cent. An amount exactly equal to the fifth is not more than a fifth and takes the middle case; an amount exactly equal to the tenth is a tenth or less and takes the last.

| Amount standing unpaid, against the contract value | Portion of the late fees settled with the balance |
|---|---|
| 30 per cent of it | the whole of them |
| exactly a fifth | half of them |
| 15 per cent of it | half of them |
| exactly a tenth | none |
| 4 per cent of it | none |
| nothing unpaid | none |

## Worked case (hypothetical contract value of USD 800000)

A fifth is USD 160000 and a tenth is USD 80000. With USD 190000 standing unpaid and USD 1300 of late fees raised, USD 1300.00 is settled with the balance; with USD 120000 standing unpaid, USD 650.00; with USD 60000 standing unpaid, nothing.
